description_1line: Engineered materials maker: PORON polyurethane foams, BISCO/Arlon silicones, DeWAL PTFE films and high-frequency circuit laminates for EV, electronics, aerospace and industrial markets.
sources: SEC Form 10-K FY2025, Rogers Corporation (CIK 0000084748), filed 2026-02-19 - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/84748/000008474826000007/rog-20251231.htm
notes: Created 2026-10-30 in integration pass 16 from EDGAR step-2 packet L2 (manifest B03). CIK 0000084748. HQ moved from Rogers, CT to Chandler, AZ in 2016; the Rogers, CT campus remains a manufacturing/innovation site (site S02). Two operating segments per FY2025 10-K Item 1: Advanced Electronics Solutions (AES - circuit materials/laminates) and Elastomeric Material Solutions (EMS - PORON/BISCO/DeWAL/Arlon foams, silicones, PTFE/UHMWPE materials). Exhibit 21 lists ~29 subsidiaries by table-row estimate (step-1 substrate); plants trade and TRI-report as Rogers Corp - no separate org grain taken. Org NAICS left blank per provenance rule (EDGAR SIC 2821 is not NAICS; plant-level TRI NAICS carried at site grain). Not the same company as held ORG-000552 Rogers Industrial Products (Akron OH) or ORG-002535 Rogers Foam Corp. (Morrisville PA) - name-token collisions checked against repo_orgs_index; no relationship asserted. Tier basis (packet): A - SEC Form 10-K FY2025 Item 1 + Item 2 + Exhibit 21 (CIK 0000084748); EPA TRI RY2023
